ruleList.ruleOverview: Do not use variable-length arrays.  Use an appropriately named, ('k' followed by CamelCase) compile-time constant for the size.
ruleList.desc: Do not use variable-length arrays.  Use an appropriately named, ('k' followed by CamelCase) compile-time constant for the size.

ruleList.desc: Are you taking an address of a cast? This is dangerous: could be a temp var. Take the address before doing the cast, rather than after

ruleList.ruleOverview:
1.Constructors callable with one argument should be marked explicit.;
 2.Single-parameter constructors should be marked explicit.
ruleList.desc:
1.Constructors callable with one argument should be marked explicit.;
 2.Single-parameter constructors should be marked explicit.

ruleList.ruleOverview: 检查是否使用了在POSIX标准中非线程安全的函数，如果使用了，给出警告。

ruleList.ruleOverview: Use int16_t/int64_t/etc, rather than the C type {match.group(1)}
ruleList.desc: Use int16_t/int64_t/etc, rather than the C type {match.group(1)}

ruleList.ruleOverview: You seem to be initializing a member variable with itself.
ruleList.desc: You seem to be initializing a member variable with itself.

ruleList.ruleOverview: Changing pointer instead of value (or unused value of operator*).
ruleList.desc: Changing pointer instead of value (or unused value of operator*).

ruleList.ruleOverview: Unary operator& is dangerous.  Do not use it
ruleList.desc: Unary operator& is dangerous.  Do not use it

ruleList.ruleOverview: %q in format strings is deprecated.  Use %ll instead.
ruleList.desc:
1. %q in format strings is deprecated.  Use %ll instead.
 2. %N$ formats are unconventional.  Try rewriting to avoid them.

ruleList.ruleOverview: Static/global string variables are not permitted.
ruleList.desc:
1.For a static/global string constant, use a C style string instead: {match.group(1)}char{match.group(2) or ""} {match.group(3)}[]".
 2. Static/global string variables are not permitted.
